scope: Isolated temporary HOME and CODEX_HOME profiles, copied plugin sources, and synthetic shell fixtures.

bundled_hook_probes.case: Portable and compatibility manifests explicitly select hooks/codex.json
Copied package places Codex hook JSON at default hooks/hooks.json
Copied package omits the Claude identity manifest while retaining portable and Codex manifests

native_hook_inventory.limitation: Bundled hooks did not appear in the tested build's native inventory; install success alone does not demonstrate hook registration.
native_hook_inventory.implemented_path: Codex setup runs init --adapter codex --mode standalone --apply against the stable runtime. Both Codex manifests set hooks to an empty array, preventing default discovery and future duplicate registration. Detach removes only tracked Codex hooks.

validation.bundled_plugin_validator: Its sole rejection is the hooks field. Current official OpenAI documentation supports explicit hook arrays in both portable extensions and compatibility manifests; all other manifest and skill checks pass.
